observations: Photo 0 shows a Volkswagen engine cover with 'TDI' and the VW logo clearly visible.
The engine cover has a textured surface with four valve covers and a circular oil filler cap.
Photo 1 shows the top of the engine with various hoses, wiring, and components. A label with a barcode is visible on the left side.
Photo 2 shows the front of the engine with more hoses, brackets, and a metal component with a label that is not legible.
All photos show a used engine in a workshop or outdoor setting with dirt and grime visible.
No visible damage to the engine cover or major components, but general wear and tear is present.

claims.evidence: The photos show only one engine. The seller's claim about all parts is not supported by the images and cannot be verified remotely.

risks.risk: Engine may not be functional or may have internal damage
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the engine running, or a detailed inspection of internal components like pistons, crankshaft, and cylinder head.

risks.risk: Engine may have been salvaged from a wrecked vehicle or have accident damage
risks.proof: Photos of the vehicle's VIN plate or a clear shot of the engine block number to verify origin and history.
risks.if_unproven: priced as salvage with unknown history

risks.risk: Engine may have mileage or wear not visible in photos
risks.proof: A close-up of the engine block with the serial number and a statement of mileage or service history.

proof_requests: Photo of the engine block serial number and VIN plate for origin verification.
Video or photo of the engine running to confirm functionality.
Close-up of the barcode label on the engine for part number identification.
Statement of mileage and service history if available.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a Volkswagen TDI engine from the visible branding on the engine cover. While the seller claims all parts are available, this cannot be verified remotely. The engine's condition and functionality are not proven, so it is priced at its worst case (as not working) until further proof is provided.
